finalMessage:
Perfect! The Porto Notes app is fully implemented and working. Here's what I've built: ## Implementation Summary ✅ **Core Features:** - Form with title, body (rich text), and optional avatar URL - Notes render newest-first in the feed - Search box with "results for..." line - Deep linking with URL fragments (`#q=query¬e=id`) - localStorage persistence with seed data from fixtures.json ✅ **Rich Text Support:** - Safe rendering of ``, ``, ``, ``, ``, `
` tags - Newlines converted to line breaks - All other HTML escaped to prevent XSS ✅ **Element Contract:** - All required IDs, classes, and attributes implemented - `#note-form`, `#title`, `#body`, `#avatar`, `#search` - `#results-line`, `#feed` - `.note`, `.note-title`, `.note-body`, `.note-avatar` - `data-note-id`, `aria-current` attributes ✅ **Build:** - Production build created in `dist/` - Smoke test passed: 6 notes rendered from fixtures - Ready to serve as static files The app is complete and functional!
